entities.name: left shift in Nav1.8 steady-state activation

relationships.subject: Nav1.8
relationships.evidence_quote: We show that Nav1.8 is an important parameter for the generation and maintenance of abnormal neuronal electrogenesis and hyperexcitability.

relationships.subject: left shift in Nav1.8 steady-state activation
relationships.evidence_quote: Based on our computational simulation, we found that a left shift in the steady state of activation of the Nav1.8 sodium channel changed the AP shape, decreased the stimulation threshold and increased the number of spikes.

key_findings: Computational DRG neuron model shows a left shift in Nav1.8 activation dominates hyperexcitability in neuropathic rats, modulated by conductance and inactivation.
Nav1.8 kinetic changes may compensate for reduced Nav1.8 expression after nerve injury.
